result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends largely on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll to integrate with your accounting software.

**If you're running a small business in Australia, I'd start by comparing Xero Payroll, MYOB, Employment Hero and QuickBooks Payroll.** Australian payroll has specific requirements around Single Touch Payroll (STP), superannuation, PAYG withholding and award rates, so US-focused recommendations such as Gusto aren't necessarily suitable.

## My top Australian payroll software picks

![Cloud-Based Payroll Services in Australia: A Complete Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZYkYUJ_i7dEguEqtJeWghzKox2V4iMBF0-msyntAs0KHARkfcw9oD02HgfuLhcuG5Os_seDsMW0p5pIuk2xW-TLpMubSFyuZHMlj7j_kil__cyTenxKPBs813_FE7e6y4sGo4jG2vV3BAcGtHs2ynqW5nRfHLw6T86QMor5VmhjEqg7gTsJjJjbXCuLDyECE?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for most small businesses)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- STP reporting and super payments.
- Employee payslips, leave and timesheets.
- Good accountant/bookkeeper integration.

Best if you already use Xero.

[Xero Australia](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for award-based employees)

- Australian Modern Award interpretation.
- Payroll, rostering and timesheets.
- HR, onboarding and employee management.
- Useful for hospitality, retail and shift workers.

[Employment Hero Australia](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. MYOB**

(Best for very small teams)

- Standalone payroll option for up to four employees.
- STP reporting and superannuation.
- Payroll and accounting integration.
- Good option if your accountant uses MYOB.

[MYOB Australia](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fAzIkPKoJM-oa11QKfYa3My-ick1YpzJYd8Tryng74VcdRfkbJ2xZicv2ZU43DJW0WJcP1njPnhG55NSb_z2iFiwUiFo9Yt5QDFBD49a3FtA1HDMKZLUF7Ngn9z6YzH4eZ2gSJcSjI6qMdFHLBZb6RvUrkChiKIcw8CPuUf5fxLPiMPyGi-bbw0ZwC7EmPBX?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Online Payroll**

- Useful accounting integration.
- Advanced payroll option includes award interpretation.
- Suitable for businesses wanting accounting and payroll together.

[QuickBooks Australia](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Reckon Payroll**

- Budget-friendly option.
- Good for micro businesses.
- Straightforward payroll and STP reporting.

[Reckon Australia](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

Sources: Australian payroll comparisons and pricing checked in October–November 2026. ## What I'd recommend

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–4 employees, basic payroll | MYOB |
| Already using Xero | Xero |
| Hospitality, retail or shift workers | Employment Hero |
| Growing business with HR needs | Employment Hero |
| Tight budget | Reckon |


One important consideration: Australia's Payday Super requirements commenced on 1 July 2026, so make sure your payroll process supports paying super each payday. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
